items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (CVE-2026-75650) under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution. Adobe published an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026, for CVE-2026-75650, rated CVSS 10.0, and is aware of it being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92, fixing seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
items.summary: This Adobe security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-26
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving important and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: Amasty Order Attributes for Magento 2 before version 4.0.0 contains an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability. This allows attackers to write executable files to the store's media directory, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Openmage Magento RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: CVE-2026-40488 is a critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability in OpenMage Magento Long Term Support (LTS). It allows authenticated attackers to upload malicious PHP files and achieve remote code execution.
